messages:
anita: Quick alert. Found a repro where per-route API keys lose their route metadata after a bulk rewrap. Embeddings-only key accepted by chat endpoints in traces. No confirmed customer exploit yet but reproducible locally.

james: ugh. which service is dropping the tag? KMS side or token-service? any logs?

anita: Rewrap worker calls KMS re-encrypt, then token-service fetches key metadata and sees route_tag null. Minimal repro attached below.

mike: paste the minimal log snippet pls

anita: log snippet:

```
2026-03-11T01:12:03Z rewrap-worker INFO rewrap start job=rw-33 key=k-992
2026-03-11T01:12:03Z kms-client DEBUG reencrypt returned_metadata={owner:acct-901}
2026-03-11T01:12:04Z token-service WARN missing-metadata key=k-992 route_tag=null
2026-03-11T01:12:04Z authz INFO falling-back-to-model-scope key=k-992 scope=model:chat
```

anita: The Vault canonical metadata includes route_tag but the rewrap path doesn't consult Vault when composing the new KMS envelope.

james: I thought rewrap copied tags. Looks like we only repack what's in the KMS blob. If a previous mirror failed, route_tag gets lost.

mike: Immediate mitigation: make authz deny if a token claims per-route scope but has no route_tag metadata. Better than silently falling back.

lucy: infra-keys will patch rewrap to read Vault canonical tags and inject them into the new envelope. If Vault lacks them, we mark the key for manual review instead of emitting a key without tags.

ci-bot: deploy: rewrap-service v1.7.0 -> v1.7.1 started by @ci-bot

mike: Proposed authz change (pseudo):

```
# old
if token.scope == 'route' and not meta.route_tag:
  allow_if_model_permits()

# new
if token.scope == 'route' and not meta.route_tag:
  audit.log('missing_route_tag', key)
  deny('missing route tag')
```

mike: I'll open a draft PR behind a feature flag authz.reject_missing_route_tag

anita: Also need detection and backfill. Query idea for audit events store:

- SQL-like: select key_id, created_at from kms_events where event='get_metadata' and tags_route_tag is null and created_at > now() - interval '7 days'

anita: prioritize keys used by customers flagged on our watchlist for manual rotation.

james: Incident classification: authz regression, potential data exposure via model-scope fallback. Set sev=3 unless we find evidence of misuse.

lucy: Patch plan for rewrap job:
1) read canonical tags from Vault for key_id
2) merge tags into re-encrypt envelope
3) log a non-blocking metric when Vault tags missing
4) add unit test ensuring route_tag survives rewrap

mike: timeline suggestion:
- 0-20m: feature-flag authz deny + enable audit query (mike, anita)
- 20-90m: run detection, identify affected keys, manual rotate high-risk ones (security + infra)
- 2-8h: deploy rewrap fix and roll out (lucy)

anita: Owners: mike (authz hotfix + smoke), lucy (rewrap fix), james (incident lead), anita (audit/backfill). I'll open the incident ticket and list owners.

mike: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/token-service/pulls/1360 (draft) feature flag authz.reject_missing_route_tag

anita: For verification after fix: create per-route key, run rewrap, confirm requests to /v1/embeddings fail if route_tag missing and succeed when present. Add e2e to staging.

lucy: adding unit test to rewrap-service repo to assert we call Vault and include tags in kms put or reencrypt. Falling back to manual review if Vault missing tags.

james: Postmortem notes: root cause = rewrap worker not consulting canonical Vault tags when creating new KMS envelopes; systemic mitigation = authz hard deny for missing route_tag, rewrap fix, audit/backfill, add CI test, and dashboard to track missing tags.

anita: Filing notify list and we'll update customers if we confirm affected keys. Good catch team :thumbsup:
